messages:
ellie: Heads up — prepping the cut at 3:00pm PT. There are 4 PRs currently blocking the merge queue: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/427 https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/430 https://git.redwood/serving/pulls/842 https://git.redwood/console/pulls/519. Can someone take a look at #427 (changelog + tagging) and #430 (backport to v1.2)? Need approvals and tags by ~14:20 PT to make the window.

mike: on it, starting review of #427 now.

jon: I'll handle the backport for #430 — ping me the target branch and I’ll open the backport PR.

priya: quick note — I left two tiny changelog comments on #427: one about the formatting and one asking to clarify the customer impact. After that it should be approvable.

mike: saw the comments, pushing a small changelog update in a force-push (fix/changelog-format).

release-bot: Reminder: merge window closes in 45 minutes (cut deadline 15:00 PT). CI gating required for all merges.

ellie: @jon target is `release-1.2.x`. Can you open backport branch like `backport/v1.2-430`? Also we need the release tag name here — let's use `v1.3.0-rc`.

jon: backport PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/438 branch `backport/v1.2-430`. cc @priya for review.

mike: approved #427, added LGTM and fixed changelog per comments.

priya: reviewing the backport now. small conflict in the Dockerfile layer, pushing a patch to the backport branch.

ellie: also, small procedural ask — use `fix` in changelog entries for user-facing bug fixes, `chore` for infra. #427 should be `fix:` not `chore:`. Thanks.

mike: updated the changelog header to `fix:` and pushed. Command I ran: `git commit -m "chore(release): changelog fix" && git push --force`.

priya: backport PR looks good now, approved and merged.

mike: CI reported one flaky test in `runtime-compat` on the merge job; rerunning the job now (jenkins: https://ci.redwood/job/12345).

release-bot: CI rerun complete — all checks green.

ellie: perfect. I'll add the tag and start the cut. Tag command: `git tag -a v1.3.0-rc -m "release candidate" && git push origin v1.3.0-rc`.

mike: tag pushed and I triggered the release job.

release-bot: Release cut started for `v1.3.0-rc` (release id: rel-2026-03-17-01). Notifying infra and marketing.

ellie: Awesome work team — I’ll post the draft release notes in #product after the artifacts are uploaded. If anything else blocks, call it out here. :tada:
